Name: Green Bamboo
Author: Axophy
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54949/54949-1793668481-406135136.gif[/img][/center]
[center] [/center]
[center][font=Georgia]🎍This mod adds bamboo as a new kind of wild tree into game🎍[/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia] [/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia]Bamboo grows in all seasons and spreads sprout quickly, but never drops seeds when you chop it or shake it.[/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia] [/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia]When shaken,  they yield Bamboo Leaves occasionally, can be used to produce Bamboo Tea.
When chopped down,  they yield Bamboo Strips, can be used to produce Bamboo Wine, woods or coals.[/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia]When tapped, they yield Fresh Bamboo Juice every day in spring, or every 2 day in other seasons.
 
The sapling (bamboo shoot) can be found in secret woods or purchased from the Traveling Cart in spring & summer.
Bamboo Shoot can be pickled to make Sour Bamboo Shoots.[/font]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54949/54949-1793805322-456866588.png[/img]
